'''Uisai''' is a [[South Bougainville languages|South Bougainville language]] of [[Bougainville Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]]. It is in the Buin language subfamily.<ref>{{cite web|title=Glottolog 2.7 - Buin|url=http://glottolog.org/resource/languoid/id/buin1247|website=glottolog.org|access-date=19 January 2017|language=en}}</ref> The language uses [[Latin script]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Uisai|url=http://www.ethnologue.com/18/language/uis/|website=Ethnologue|access-date=19 January 2017}}</ref>
